text: The working people of Southern California deserve a strong advocate in Congress. County Supervisor

That's why Hilda Solis is the candidate in the 38th District endorsed by nurses, firefighters, deputies, small business owners, Planned Parenthood Action Fund, and unions representing tens of thousands of working families.
Hilda Solis has demonstrated that she stands up for the people – not the powerful – as an educator, lawmaker, U.S. Representative, President Barack Obama's Secretary of Labor, and county supervisor.
